_comment: Rationale for these keys lives in core/pipeline.py, in the comment block immediately above _render_fcl_overrides (Task 14, lifted from Task 13's STAGE_FCL["mustops_ce"]). Edit that comment block, not this note, when the rationale changes. desc_fmt/output_glob/njobs (Task 6, lifted from the retired STAGES["mustops_ce"] literal) are per-stage orchestration constants -- desc_fmt is the json2jobdef description format, output_glob is the file pattern this stage emits regardless of geometry, njobs is the default grid job count (mode specs may override via run.jobs_per_stage; see core/pipeline.py stage_cfg()). njobs/events tuning history, carried verbatim from the retired STAGES["mustops_ce"] comment: 100 jobs per A/B noise test on helical001 (2026-05-16) -- half-vs-half ce_seen agreed to 0.4% at 97 jobs each, well below GP noise floor. njobs=200 (then core/runtime.py STAGE_TARGETS, retired 2026-08-19 into core/pipeline.py stage_cfg()) paired with events=2500 preserves total CE statistics at 500k events while halving per-job wall-time and doubling per-cluster parallelism. 2026-05-21 PM: SR00_00's long-tail (dx=0.011 -> N_crit~4144 -> 3-4h CPU/job, 5x normal) showed the implicit throughput gate; halving events_per_job halves per-job CPU cost at constant total statistics. The earlier 2026-05-21 AM reversion to events_per_job=5000 was made WITHOUT compensating njobs, which halved stats and moved sigma(sob) 0.10 -> 0.14; the 200x2500 pairing restores it. Stamped at submit -- see wiki/incidents/events-per-job-mid-flight-edit.md.
